old: The connection pool does not block when it is full (False).
new: The connection pool blocks when it is full (True).

old: The default pool timeout is None.
new: The default pool timeout is 5 seconds.

old: After a 303 See Other redirect the request method changes to GET.
new: After a 303 See Other redirect the request method stays unchanged.

old: The Authorization header is removed when a redirect goes to another host.
new: The Authorization header is kept when a redirect goes to another host.

old: Proxy settings are rebuilt on every redirect.
new: Proxy settings are rebuilt only once per request.

old: A client may send at most 100 requests per minute.
new: A client may send at most 50 requests per minute.
note: this library has no rate limiter, so no HIGH match should come
